services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: This Hawaiian Parasail experience is a fantastic option for those wishing to fly! About You will be able to utilize a harness method that entails a dry takeoff and landing directly from the boat and have the option of a teabag dip in the water or a completely dry flight, whichever suits your fancy. A maximum of 11-15 people are allowed on the boat. Participants who are 15 yrs old and under are required to have a Non-flying participant or Observer. A great way to enjoy the beauty of this tropical paradise from the sea and the air, experience an unforgettable parasail thrill ride, and fly high on this exciting adventure! Important Information: Duration: Every boat ride could be up to an hour,

faq.a: It is dependent on weight & wind ratio. Most of the time it is possible. The weight cannot exceed 450 lbs. between the three riders. The captain has the final say.

faq.q: ow long is the boat ride?
faq.a: You are out on the boat for nearly an hour. If you'll need a transportation, it's going to be 2 hours door to door duration.
Yes. We do provide complimentary round trip transportation to and from major hotels in Waikiki.

faq.q: ow many participants can the boat take out at once?
faq.a: The boats are US Coast Guard Inspected for 12-15 riders and 2 crews.
